POV: What looks like a simple bamboo basket is actually a piece of Vietnam’s living history. 🎋🇻🇳✨

In Vietnam, bamboo isn’t just a plant. It’s part of everyday life, tradition, and generations of craftsmanship. ❤️

From beautifully handwoven baskets and traditional hats to everyday household items, Vietnamese artisans transform simple strips of bamboo and rattan into incredible works of art. 🧺

Every weave takes patience. Every pattern carries a story. Every handmade piece reflects skills passed down through generations.

No machines. No shortcuts. Just skilled hands, creativity, and traditions worth preserving. ✨

Because the most beautiful souvenirs aren’t always the most expensive ones — they’re the ones with a story behind them. 🤎

📍 Vietnam

POV: What looks like a simple bamboo basket is actually a piece of Vietnam’s living history. 🎋🇻🇳✨

data.description: The number of saves of your posts, reels and videos.

data.name: shares
data.title: Shares
data.description: The number of shares of your posts, stories, reels, videos and live videos.

data.name: reach
data.title: Accounts reached
data.description: The number of unique accounts that have seen your content, at least once, including in ads. Content includes posts, stories, reels, videos and live videos. Reach is different from impressions, which may include multiple views of your content by the same accounts. This metric is estimated and in development.

data.name: views
data.title: Views
data.description: The number of times your content was played or displayed. Content includes reels, posts, stories.

data.name: profile_views
data.title: Profile visits
data.description: The number of times that your profile was visited.

data.name: website_clicks
data.title: Website link taps
data.description: The number of times that the link to your website was tapped.

data.name: total_interactions
data.title: Content interactions
data.description: The total number of post interactions, story interactions, reels interactions, video interactions and live video interactions, including any interactions on boosted content.

data.name: accounts_engaged
data.title: Accounts engaged
data.description: The number of accounts that have interacted with your content, including in ads. Content includes posts, stories, reels, videos and live videos. Interactions can include actions such as likes, saves, comments, shares or replies. These metrics are estimated and in development.
